description: FREE preflight for access_crawl. Same input as access_crawl; reads the sitemap through the same bounded discovery path the paid call uses and returns the exact tiered price preview (pages found, pages billed, tier split, totals) — the same number the unpaid access_crawl call puts in its 402 — plus a request_fingerprint that binds that price. No page is rendered and nothing is charged. — no payment required: call directly without payment (no x402 challenge; this tool is free). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/access/crawl/preflight.
name: access_crawl_preflight
